title: #59 School Advertisements
prompt: Some people think placing advertisements in school is a great resource for public schools that need additional funding, but others think it exploits children by treating them as a captive audience for corporate sponsors. Choose which position you most agree with and discuss why you choose that position. Support your point of view with details from your own experiences, observations or reading.

promptSegments.text: Some people think placing advertisements in school is a great resource for public schools that need additional funding, but others think it exploits children by treating them as a captive audience for corporate sponsors.
Choose which position you most agree with and discuss why you choose that position.
Support your point of view with details from your own experiences, observations or reading.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph argues that advertisements provide necessary funding for schools to buy new resources and equipment.

angles.en: The second body paragraph discusses the opposing view, stating that advertisements might distract students and negatively affect their focus on learning.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph argues that ads create discomfort and distraction for students, supporting the view that ads exploit children.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first body paragraph argues that ads create discomfort and distraction for students, supporting the view that ads exploit children.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second body paragraph addresses the opposing view that ads help schools earn money, but the conclusion maintains the original stance.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second body paragraph addresses the opposing view that ads help schools earn money, but the conclusion maintains the original stance.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph argues that ads provide financial support, using the example of a local bank. The structure follows PEEL: Point (financial support), Explain (money for equipment), Example (local bank ad), Effect (buying computers), Link (advertising helps improve resources).
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first body paragraph argues that ads provide financial support, using the example of a local bank. The structure follows PEEL: Point (financial support), Explain (money for equipment), Example (local bank ad), Effect (buying computers), Link (advertising helps improve resources).

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second body paragraph discusses the opposing view, arguing that ads distract students. The structure follows PEEL: Point (ads distract), Explain (too many ads might distract), Example (posters about goods), Effect (spending time looking at ads), Link (negative learning environment).
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second body paragraph discusses the opposing view, arguing that ads distract students. The structure follows PEEL: Point (ads distract), Explain (too many ads might distract), Example (posters about goods), Effect (spending time looking at ads), Link (negative learning environment).

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The argument focuses on how ads exploit students' feelings and sense of self-worth.
